SELECT su.id, su.openid, su.unionid, su.mobile, su.nickname, su.real_name AS realName, su.id_card AS idCard, su.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, su.status, su.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, su.created_at AS createdAt, su.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sys_user su WHERE 1 = 1
AND su.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{sysUser.nickname},'%')
AND su.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{sysUser.mobile},'%')
AND su.status = #{sysUser.status}
ORDER BY su.created_at DESC
